title: Puthoff, MK Ultra and the remote viewing programs

tellings.quote: obviously Halutoff was involved in both UFOs side of this as well as the consciousness side of this and of course MK Ultra was maybe the more weaponized version of the consciousness research and remote viewing programs were the more you know tradecraftraft sort of application

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff worked on both UFOs and research into the mind, and in that world MK Ultra, the CIA's mind-control experiments with drugs, was the weapon side, while remote viewing, the effort to see distant places with the mind alone, was the spycraft side. The researcher Matthew Pines lays this out for Michels without naming a source, linking the UFO and mind programs through one man.
